Sacred Destinations

What Makes Our Himalayas Special

The Kumaon Himalayas hide some of India's most sacred and least-visited shrines. Our routes take you to places few outsiders ever see.

Om Parvat

Natural snow formation of the sacred Om symbol on the mountain face – a divine spectacle.

Adi Kailash

The smaller twin of Mount Kailash, equally sacred and far more accessible for pilgrims.

Parvati Sarovar

Holy lake at Jolingkong where Goddess Parvati performed her sacred ablutions.

Darma Valley

Remote, pristine valley with traditional Bhotiya culture and Panchachuli base camp access.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before planning your Himalayan pilgrimage or trek.

The ideal window is May–June and September–October. Monsoon (July–August) brings heavy rainfall and potential landslides, which makes the route risky. Winter months (November–April) see the route closed due to heavy snowfall.

For the 4-day and 6-day packages, no prior trekking experience is required – moderate fitness is sufficient. For the Darma Valley 5-day adventure package, some prior hiking or trekking experience is recommended as altitudes reach 4,400 m.

The Adi Kailash and Om Parvat route passes through a restricted border area requiring an Inner Line Permit (ILP). We handle all permit paperwork as part of our package. You only need to provide your government photo ID (Aadhar/Passport).

Accommodation ranges from guesthouses and KMVN (Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam) guest houses in larger villages, to tents and basic shelters at higher altitudes. All our packages include meals. We aim for comfortable, clean stays at every location.

Essential items include warm layered clothing (temperatures drop below freezing at high altitude), waterproof jacket, trekking shoes, sunscreen (SPF 50+), sunglasses, personal medications, and a good water bottle. We provide a detailed packing list upon booking.

Seniors in good health regularly complete our pilgrimage packages. However, high-altitude trekking is not suitable for those with serious heart or lung conditions. We recommend consulting your doctor before booking and informing us of any health conditions so we can plan appropriately.
